_about: Limits for the real style's trees and grass, for tools/look.mjs --check against tools/look/trees.json (npm run check:trees, which also runs tools/trees_check.mjs): the trees are leaves, tubes and cards, the near ground has blades, and a car at rest has still trees. trees.json is what the page gave of the same shots without them (the trees of balls and cones, no blades). A rule: { shot, metric, min, max }, or against it: { ..., of: 'baseline', minRatio, maxRatio }.

rules.why: the trees are leaves and not facets: how much of them is one flat colour (a pixel within 0.008 of L of each of its four neighbours) is at most 0.15 (0.031 measured; 0.585 with the trees of balls and cones)

the trees are leaves and not facets: how much of them is one flat colour (a pixel within 0.008 of L of each of its four neighbours) is at most 0.15 (0.007 measured; 0.127 with the trees of balls and cones)

the trees are leaves and not facets: how much of them is one flat colour (a pixel within 0.008 of L of each of its four neighbours) is at most 0.15 (0.11 measured; 0.272 with the trees of balls and cones)
leaves are fine detail, neither smooth nor a speckle: how much a pixel of the trees differs from its four neighbours in L is 0.06 to 0.14 (0.0858 measured; 0.0224 before)
the trees are many colours, not a few: nine tenths of their pixels need at least 28 colours (30 measured; 20 before; the lens looks toward the sun there, so the crowns are dark)
trees changing over from one way of being drawn to the next do not show: the most of the frame that changes between two views half a metre apart is at most 0.003 (0.0014 measured; 0.0012 before)
the near trees of a car at rest are at rest: how much their L changes in a sixtieth of a second is at most 0.006 (0.0008 measured)
the ground near the lens has blades: how many of its pixels have an upright edge (a step of L over 0.03 to the neighbour on one side) is at least 0.06 (0.318 measured; 0.0289 before)
and the edges are upright, as a blade's are: the change across the near ground over the change up and down is at least 1.1 (1.171 measured; 0.561 before)
the near ground is many greens: nine tenths of its pixels need 25 to 60 colours (30 measured; 14 before)
the blades leave the near ground about as light as it was (0.475 measured; 0.509 before)
the trees and the blades do not cost more than 1.9 M triangles a frame (1.09 M measured; 0.83 M before)

the real style's blades are at most 450000 triangles (417829 in the frame, with the clutter's 44009)
